aggregate_behavior.distinguished_subtraction: when the second list is non-empty, the distinguished object's three terms are subtracted from the total (its two slot results first, then its direct qword)
aggregate_behavior.empty_first_list: the first loop is skipped when the first node's pointer equals the first-list header
aggregate_behavior.empty_second_list: the second loop is skipped when the first node's pointer equals the second-list header, and the distinguished block is skipped as well, so the distinguished object is never read
aggregate_behavior.total: sum of the per-element terms over every node of the first list, plus the same sum over every node of the second list

callees_by_contract.slot_0x78: virtual accessor called on the subobjects at payload + 0xa50 and payload + 0xa58 in every loop and in the distinguished block; its result is taken as an input value, internals not modelled

census_notes.confirmation: every census site was confirmed as a real e8 call in objdump output disassembled from its containing FDE start (0x5f1327b inside 0x5f13240, 0x5f1345c inside 0x5f13450)
census_notes.method: per-byte scan of the .text file bytes for e8/e9 opcodes, decoding the rel32 target in objdump virtual-address space (.text file offset = VA - 0x1000), plus a whole-file qword search for the target VA and a .rela.dyn parse for R_X86_64_RELATIVE slots whose addend is the target

refresh.stores: the aggregate of the object at holder + 0x08 is stored to holder + 0x20, and a byte flag at holder + 0x28 records whether that object's second list is non-empty

threshold.fallback_arm: when field + 0x38 is not greater than 0, the result is false when the sign-extended dword at field + 0x30 is not greater than 0, otherwise (field + 0x10 + field + 0x28) > sign-extended field + 0x30, compared unsigned with 64-bit wrapping addition
threshold.positive_arm: when the caller's field + 0x38 is greater than 0 (signed), the result is (base argument + aggregate) >= field + 0x38, compared unsigned

object_layout.distinguished_object: object + 0x20 (a pointer, read only when the second list is non-empty)
object_layout.list1_header: object + 0x00 (next at + 0x00, walk ends at the header itself)
object_layout.list2_header: object + 0x18 (next at + 0x18, walk ends at the header itself)
object_layout.node: next pointer at node + 0x00, payload pointer at node + 0x10
object_layout.payload: subobject pointers at payload + 0xa50 and payload + 0xa58, direct qword at payload + 0xa00

per_element_terms.arithmetic: all additions and subtractions are 64-bit wrapping
per_element_terms.description: for one payload, the window adds three values: the slot-0x78 result of the subobject at payload + 0xa50, the slot-0x78 result of the subobject at payload + 0xa58, and the qword at payload + 0xa00
per_element_terms.order: first-list and second-list loops add the two slot results first, then the direct qword; the distinguished block adds the same three terms and then subtracts both partial sums from the total

unknowns: the owning component and the meaning of the two lists and of the distinguished object at + 0x20; only their layout and the arithmetic are pinned
the identity of the slot-0x78 accessors; their results are inputs to the model, not derived values
why the distinguished object is subtracted exactly when the second list is non-empty; the rule is recorded literally, its reason is not claimed
